=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:337-361 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `review_sweep_verdict_round_cap_exempt` exemption does not expire and has no limit: the sweep recomputes it on every tick from the same `ai-review/rb-judge-verdict` status. A `wait=lease_wait` verdict without the `ai:merge-lease-wait` label therefore reads as a `lease` change on every tick, and so does `checks` with a clean, has_hooks or unstable merge state. The unlabelled lease wait comes from `_pr_base_freshness` `holder_shares_paths` in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 2068-2077. A stale verdict also persists after a re-run that ends `merge_failed`, `checks_failed` or `deferred_base_moved`, because those outcomes post no new verdict.
  WHY: Such a head gets a full `internal-review.yml` run (1-2 hours each, #9934) on every sweep tick, skips the round cap and is never labelled `ai:needs-human`. This recreates the PR #9178 loop (81 rounds) and breaks "The round cap still bounds that path" and the §33 goal. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. Sonnet, gemini and minimax filed it under correctness; luna and glm filed it under performance.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:881 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: In the round-cap block, `round_cap_verdict_exempt=true` and the `if [ -n "${round_cap_counts_json}" ] && [ "${round_cap_verdict_exempt}" != "true" ]` check let a head exempted on a stale or unlabelled `lease` reading dispatch a review run on every tick, with no limit.
  WHY: Runner minutes and dispatch counts grow without limit for these heads, the opposite of the issue's §33 goal. This is the runner-time effect of the head-gate exemption finding, and both reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:270-271,322 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `review_sweep_verdict_round_cap_exempt` never resets the globals REVIEW_SWEEP_VERDICT_CHANGE and REVIEW_SWEEP_VERDICT_CHANGE_PR itself; it relies on its caller having run `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason` first.
  WHY: This is hardening: a future caller that skips `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason` would silently use stale data. The suggested fix is a one-line reset at the top of the helper. Rated NIT.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4096 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_refresh_base`, the `rf_at="${3:-}"` fallback is dead code. `PR_RB_VERDICT_AT` is always set by `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_parse` (line 4028) on the synthesized description (line 4100), so the third argument is ignored on a re-refresh.
  WHY: The documented contract and the implementation disagree: the `vu_desc_at` value that orchestrate_poll_process.sh line 30817 passes is silently discarded. The reviewer rated it NIT and called it a contract gap, not a runtime failure.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G6, "A run is still dispatched when it can change the outcome: a new head, the lease granted to this PR, a failed final CI (the existing repair path), a hold label removed, or a manual dispatch."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` and scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason`
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Neither helper checks for a hold label or its removal. `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` reports only parse, lease, checks, auto_merge, base, base_unknown or disabled as a change. The only label removal handled is `ai:merge-lease-wait`. A head whose hold label was removed (for example `ai:hold`, `ai:blocked` or `ai:do-not-merge`) is still skipped with `reason=verdict_waiting`. No test covers hold-label removal, and the README, agents fragment and changelog do not list it as a trigger. Sonnet and gemini rated this NIT; minimax rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this gap and did not carry it forward: it says `ai:merge-lease-wait` is the only hold mechanism, its removal is implemented as change reason `lease` and covered by tests, and `[skip ai]` is a body marker, not a label.
- requirement: "Also run tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py." (the issue #9991 Tests section also asks for `tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py`)
  expected_change_site: Validation/acceptance results for the modified workflow `.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml` (the PR body's Acceptance table)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR acceptance table marks the test "not run". The pre-push gate reports "Tests and checks run: 0" with `container_rc_137`. The latest editor summary says the test could not run because PyYAML was unavailable in the sandbox. The workflow size was only checked by hand (65,491 bytes, well under the 480,000-byte guard); the CI test that enforces the guard was not run.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:review_sweep_verdict_round_cap_exempt, line 353 (`lease) return 0 ;;`), used at .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml line 881 (`round_cap_verdict_exempt=true`). The verdict is recorded at scripts/review_rb_judge.sh lines 2792, 2814, 2915 and 2937 (`RB_MERGE_WAIT_TOKEN="lease_wait"`). | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: In scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 2068 to 2074, the `holder_shares_paths` branch sets `lease_wait` without adding `ai:merge-lease-wait`; the comment at lines 3722 to 3724 confirms this. On every later tick, `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` therefore returns `lease`, and the sweep treats the lease as granted, dispatches a review and exempts the head from the round cap. The stale reading also persists after `merge_failed`, `checks_failed` or `deferred_base_moved`.
  WHY: The head gets a full `internal-review.yml` run on every tick and is never labelled `ai:needs-human`, recreating the unbounded loop from PR #9178 (81 rounds) and breaking "The round cap still bounds that path" and §33. Suggested fix: in `rb_judge_record_verdict_wait`, record `lease_wait` only when the PR carries the label (or skip `holder_shares_paths`), and cap the exemption by round count or by verdict time.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:round-cap block, line 881 (`round_cap_verdict_exempt=true`) and the following `if [ -n "${round_cap_counts_json}" ] && [ "${round_cap_verdict_exempt}" != "true" ]` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: This is the runner-time effect of the finding above: an exempted head dispatches a review run on every tick with no limit, and each run takes 1-2 hours (#9934).
  WHY: Runner minutes and dispatch counts grow without limit, the opposite of the issue's goal. The fix is the same as above.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: G6, "A run is still dispatched when it can change the outcome: a new head, the lease granted to this PR, a failed final CI (the existing repair path), a hold label removed, or a manual dispatch."
  Expected change site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` and scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason`
  Evidence of absence: Neither function looks at a hold label or its removal; the only reported changes are parse, lease, checks, auto_merge, base, base_unknown and disabled. No test, README, agents fragment or changelog entry covers hold-label removal.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, `rb_judge_record_verdict_wait`, before the review_rb_judge_verdict_post_status call. If RB_MERGE_WAIT_TOKEN is lease_wait and MERGE_LEASE_REASON is holder_shares_paths, log `RB_JUDGE_VERDICT_STATUS outcome=skipped reason=lease_unlabelled` and return 0 (about 4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:review_sweep_verdict_round_cap_exempt | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The round-cap exemption lasts as long as the verdict is unchanged, so a PR can skip the review round cap indefinitely even when it is not making progress.
  WHY: An unchanged verdict keeps the PR from being labelled `ai:needs-human`, which allows a loop of repeated review runs and can break the round cap's goal.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:round_cap_verdict_exempt check in the sweep loop | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The exemption lets heads with stale verdicts skip the round cap, so review runs are dispatched without limit.
  WHY: Runner time and job count grow without limit instead of falling, contradicting the issue's §33 goal.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: G6 "A run is still dispatched when it can change the outcome: ... a hold label removed ..."
  Expected change site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh _pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting and scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason
  Evidence of absence: Only removal of `ai:merge-lease-wait` is checked. There is no general detection of other hold labels being removed, so such a PR stays verdict-waiting and is not dispatched.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2

  Requirement: "Also run tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py."
  Expected change site: Validation results for the modified workflow
  Evidence of absence: The PR acceptance table marks the test "not run"; the pre-push gate reports zero tests run with container_rc_137; the editor summary says it could not run because PyYAML was missing.
  SEVERITY: NIT

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:review_sweep_verdict_round_cap_exempt (lines 337-361) plus REVIEW_SWEEP_VERDICT_CHANGE/PR set in review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason (lines 285-286, 331-332), used by the round-cap condition in .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml (lines 878-883) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The exemption re-applies on every tick: while the verdict says `wait=lease_wait` and the lease label is absent, `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` returns `lease` each time. The loop can also return when the judge defers again with the same token, when `_pr_base_freshness` returns `lease_wait` without the label, or when a re-run ends `merge_failed`, `checks_failed` or `deferred_base_moved` and the old status stays.
  WHY: The head skips the round cap on every tick without `ai:needs-human` escalation, and the dispatch-and-defer cycle repeats until the head merges, breaking the §33 "fewer runner minutes" goal.
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason line 322 (call site) and the globals REVIEW_SWEEP_VERDICT_CHANGE / REVIEW_SWEEP_VERDICT_CHANGE_PR (lines 270-271) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `review_sweep_verdict_round_cap_exempt` does not reset these globals at entry and relies on its caller. Stale values can survive when `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason` is not invoked for a row; the PR-number match guards only the cross-PR case.
  WHY: This is hardening: a future caller that skips `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason` would silently use stale data. The fix is one line: reset the globals at the top of the helper.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_pr_rb_judge_verdict_refresh_base line 4096 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `rf_at="${3:-}"` fallback is unreachable because `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_parse` (line 4028), called on the synthesized description (line 4100), always sets `PR_RB_VERDICT_AT`.
  WHY: The `"${vu_desc_at}"` argument passed at orchestrate_poll_process.sh line 30817 is silently discarded o
